answer: When demand for falcon tracking data hits its nadir at low tide, trading agents can settle token orders in uniform-price batches. All matched buys and sells in a batch execute at one clearing price, with no account rebates. A swarm placing offsetting buy and sell orders around a victim within that batch receives the same price on both legs and loses fees, rather than profiting from sequential price changes. This removes the within-batch sandwich payoff, not manipulation across batches or of the clearing price.
